events.title: Ultimate Manhunt
events.location: Living Word Baptist Church, Sweet Valley, PA
events.description: A nighttime tracking-and-navigation challenge where Trailmen race to find hidden Lost Patrols, recover their patrol markers, and make it back to Command before time runs out. ULTIMATE MANHUNT — Find the Lost Patrol No tricks. Just adventure. A Better Halloween Alternative. Friday, October 30, 2026 • 6:00–9:30 p.m. Living Word Baptist Church, Sweet Valley, PA Trail Life Troop PA-1997’s October outdoor-skills capstone. Finder patrols use maps, tracking signs, observation, teamwork, and limited guesses to locate hidden Navigator/Adventurer Lost Patrol sites and recover patrol markers. Lost Patrols remain concealed in assigned quadrants and compete to protect as many markers as possible. Planned features: maps, tracking, radios, camouflage, glow-stick quadrant boundaries, campfire base camp, prizes, hot dogs, trail mix, hot apple cider, and Dutch-oven apple crisp. Awards include Ultimate Search Patrol, Ultimate Lost Patrol, Ghost of the Woods, and Night Hunter. Contact: tltrooppa1997@gmail.com Hit the Trail
